lesson: With zeta's functional equation fixed, the family is zeta times a symmetric multiplier. Small-defect controls are absolutely continuous (rational multipliers); discrete ones sit at distance >= 1. A U1/U2 device must name the step that reads absence of coefficient mass off log N, or the sign of Lambda against a density of size O(eta^2+d^2); otherwise ZQ passes it. T-NR in symmetric normalisation already had zeta's FE (map row NR), so "no control on file has it" was imprecise.
